status: changes required for released R1 hashes; both defects independently reproduced on Node and Bun

findings.title: reject ABI-compatible modules without required transport exports before returning a backend
findings.detail: A valid native module exporting abi_version=1 and no-op __wbindgen_start only is admitted and pinned as a wasm backend. Its first add-int throws raw TypeError from generated glue because __wbindgen_free is absent. This violates wrong-exports rejection and stable startup failure rather than delayed request failure.
findings.generated_start_import_dependency: __wbindgen_externrefs table is used by generated __wbindgen_init_externref_table; structural_abi_version/validation_call belong to separate structural consumer and need no new acceptance claim here.
findings.test_gap: workerd.mjs:47-48 and :120-123 use entirely empty module, which fails at __wbindgen_start and cannot prove transport export validation after successful ABI/start.

findings.title: avoid invoking caller-overridable every method for pinned byte equality
findings.detail: After bootstrap(valid), create same-length corrupt Uint8Array, set byte0=255 and corrupt.every=()=>true. bootstrap(corrupt) silently returns cached backend, and add-int yields 5. Input remains an actual Uint8Array admitted by the documented contract. Use intrinsic/private normalized comparison, retaining private immutable pin.

test_false_positive_risks.detail: Caller mutation test runs after first success at lines91-97, so the later bytes being mutated were never the first pinned asset. An implementation retaining the initial input reference instead of copying it can still pass this test. Add fresh-process first-input mutation control.

Missing/corrupt native loader checks assert any rejection; raw successful workerd log confirms expected missing-module and corrupt-magic errors in this release. Preserve diagnostic context when refreshing.
